steps.name: operator-action-contract-foundation
steps.summary: Added framework-neutral operator action contracts for cancelOrder/retryOutboxMessage/replayMessage commands, JSON-safe results, audit records, ADMIN-only action policy, public API exports, and contract tests while preserving read-only OperatorApi routes.

steps.name: operator-cancel-order-action
steps.summary: Connected ADMIN cancelOrder operator actions to CancelOrderCommand/OrderCommandHandler with deterministic command ids, handler result mapping, rejection handling, audit recording, and focused contract tests.

steps.name: operator-outbox-retry-replay-actions
steps.summary: Added framework-neutral operator retryOutboxMessage/replayMessage services with port request contracts, duplicate/validation result mapping, audit payloads, and focused tests without changing relay or idempotency deletion contracts.

steps.name: operator-action-http-routes
steps.summary: Connected cancelOrder/retryOutboxMessage/replayMessage operator actions to framework-neutral HTTP routes, public route manifests, WSGI previews, and JSON response mappings for accepted, duplicate, rejected, validation, and forbidden outcomes.

steps.name: operator-action-phase-verification
steps.summary: Added operator action public contract tests and README/app README documentation to verify public exports, phase 7 plus phase 8 route manifests, framework-neutral import boundaries, bounded api/serve-api previews, and next phase candidates without starting live Docker/Kafka publish.
